title: First one Leo vs Ursus Series: Gen-1
summary: Always love this series and the Gen-1 does not dissapoint. Surprisingly smooth for an IIPA. The normal explosion 💥 of hops with Citra and mosaic but without that too juiciness of most New England. Overall good balance.
author: Greg McVerry

Always love this series and the Gen-1 does not dissapoint. Surprisingly smooth for an IIPA. The normal explosion 💥 of hops with Citra and mosaic but without that too juiciness of most New England.
